name: smartfix-backend
description: Runs the SmartFix backend services locally. Each service has its own package.json.

scripts.install:all: node -e "for (const d of ['api-gateway','user-service','payment-service','booking-service','catalog-service','repair-service','inventory-service']) require('child_process').execSync('npm install', { cwd: d, stdio: 'inherit' })"
